input.title: 2025 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 360 XR
input.descriptionHtml:
Financing Available!*

Book a FREE On-Water Demo!


The Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 360XR is a state-of-the-art fishing kayak, blending advanced technology with user-friendly features. It stands out for its innovative MirageDrive 360, providing unparalleled maneuverability. This kayak is designed for anglers seeking optimal performance, comfort, and versatility on the water, with upgraded components like the robust drive well and intuitive clutch assembly enhancing its durability and ease of use. It's a top-tier choice for those who demand the best in kayak fishing. An impressive upgrade over the already outstanding Pro Angler 14 360

 

Specs:
Length: 13' 8" / 4.17 m
Width: 38" / .97 m
Hull Weight: 124.5 LBS / 56.5 KG
Fully Rigged Weight: 148.5 LBS / 67.4 KG
Capacity: 600 lbs / 272 kg
Vantage Seat Capacity: 350 lbs / 159 kg
Crew: 1
 

 
*Must be approved by Synchrony Financial with a large enough credit line to cover the purchase price. Call (815) 433-2200 for more info

Check out our available kayak accessories on our eShop!

Key Features:

MirageDrive 360 Technology: Experience unmatched maneuverability with the innovative MirageDrive 360. This system allows for effortless 360-degree navigation, enabling precise positioning and easy navigation through tight spots.

Enhanced Drive Well and Clutch Assembly:The updated drive well and clutch assembly of the Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 360XR represent significant advancements in kayak design. The drive well now directly integrates with the kayak's rotomolded hull, using stainless steel plates for enhanced strength and durability. This new configuration ensures a more reliable and robust connection. The clutch assembly has been completely redesigned, offering improved on-water adjustability. Key features include a new locking knob and a release mechanism, making adjustments easier and more intuitive, all accessible from the kayak seat. These upgrades significantly enhance the kayak's performance and user experience.

Advanced Steering System:The XR steering system includes a drive lock feature, allowing the drive to be securely locked in a forward position for stable and straight tracking.
A steering release feature adds versatility, enabling manual adjustment of the drive orientation, crucial in challenging situations.

Ultimate Comfort and Storage:The Vantage ST seat offers unmatched comfort with adjustable lumbar support, perfect for long fishing excursions.
Abundant storage options, including horizontal rod storage and a large front hatch, cater to all your gear needs.

Customization and Control:Customize your fishing experience with the H-Rail System, allowing for easy mounting of accessories.
The Guardian Retractable Transducer Shield enhances fishfinder performance, ensuring you never miss a catch.

Included With the Kayak:

MirageDrive 360 with Kick-up Turbo Fins
Lowrance Ready System with Guardian Retractable Transducer Shield
Dual Steering Controls
Replaceable Mounting Boards
Two-Piece 260 cm Paddle with On-Hull Storage Clips and T-Handle
8" Twist and Seal Hatch
Accessory Mount for Optional Sail or Canopy
Anchor Trolley System Ready
Vantage ST Seating
Boa System Lumbar Support
Front and Rear Carrying Handles
Horizontal Storage for 4 Rods
Large Covered Bow Hatch with Removable Liner
Large Rectangular Hatch with Pivoting Tackle Management System
Livewell-Ready Cargo Area
Retractable Rudder System
Under Seat Tackle Storage
Molded-In Vertical Storage for 2 Rods
Retractable Tracking Skeg
2 Plano Tackle Boxes
2 H-Rail Rod Racks
1 H-Rail Cup Holder
Hookless Mesh-Covered Stowage Pockets
